headline: Lightspeed Reports Q2 2027 Revenue of $323.8 Million
summary: Lightspeed Commerce reported second-quarter revenue of $323.8 million, representing 15% year-over-year organic growth. The company saw gross profit of $142.8 million across its retail and hospitality segments.
why: Lightspeed provides point-of-sale and e-commerce software for small and medium-sized businesses, serving as a proxy for retail and hospitality sector health.
